differential-power-analysis.pseudocode:
def dpa_key_byte(traces, plaintexts):
    best_k, best_peak = None, 0
    for k in range(256):  # 키 바이트 후보 전수
        g0, g1 = [], []
        for t, p in zip(traces, plaintexts):
            bit = SBOX[p ^ k] & 1  # 선택 함수: 중간값 LSB
            (g1 if bit else g0).append(t)
        diff = mean(g1) - mean(g0)  # 시점별 평균 파형 차
        peak = max(abs(v) for v in diff)
        if peak > best_peak:  # 맞는 추측에서만 큰 피크
            best_k, best_peak = k, peak
    return best_k

diffie-hellman.pseudocode:
def dh_keypair(p, g):
    x = random_int(2, p - 2)  # 비밀값
    return x, pow(g, x, p)  # (비밀값, 공개값 g^x mod p)

# Alice와 Bob은 공개값만 교환
a, YA = dh_keypair(p, g)
b, YB = dh_keypair(p, g)
k_alice = pow(YB, a, p)  # (g^b)^a
k_bob = pow(YA, b, p)  # (g^a)^b
assert k_alice == k_bob  # g^(ab) mod p
session_key = KDF(k_alice)  # 대칭 세션키로 유도

diffusion-model.pseudocode:
# 학습 (DDPM): 노이즈 예측 오차 최소화
def train_step(x0, model, alpha_bar, T):
    t = randint(1, T)
    eps = normal_like(x0)
    a = alpha_bar[t]
    xt = sqrt(a) * x0 + sqrt(1 - a) * eps  # 한 번에 x_t
    loss = mse(eps, model(xt, t))
    update(model, loss)

# 샘플링: x_T 노이즈에서 x_0까지 역방향 반복
def sample(model, alpha, alpha_bar, sigma, T, shape):
    x = normal(shape)  # x_T
    for t in range(T, 0, -1):
        z = normal(shape) if t > 1 else 0
        eps = model(x, t)
        c = (1 - alpha[t]) / sqrt(1 - alpha_bar[t])
        x = (x - c * eps) / sqrt(alpha[t]) + sigma[t] * z
    return x  # x_0

digital-signal-processor.pseudocode:
def fir(x, h):  # y[n] = Σ h[k]·x[n-k]
    N = len(h)
    buf = [0.0] * N  # 지연선(원형 버퍼)
    y, pos = [], 0
    for sample in x:
        buf[pos] = sample
        acc, idx = 0.0, pos
        for k in range(N):
            # DSP는 이 곱셈-누산을 1사이클에 수행
            acc += h[k] * buf[idx]
            idx = (idx - 1) % N
        y.append(acc)
        pos = (pos + 1) % N
    return y

dijkstra-algorithm.pseudocode:
def dijkstra(graph, s):
    # graph[u] = [(v, w), ...], 모든 w >= 0
    dist = {v: INF for v in graph}
    dist[s] = 0
    pq = MinHeap()
    pq.push((0, s))
    done = set()
    while pq:
        d, u = pq.pop()  # 누적 거리 최소 정점
        if u in done:
            continue  # 이미 확정된 정점(낡은 항목)
        done.add(u)
        for v, w in graph[u]:
            if d + w < dist[v]:  # 간선 완화
                dist[v] = d + w
                pq.push((dist[v], v))
    return dist

discount-factor.pseudocode:
def discounted_returns(rewards, gamma=0.99):
    # rewards[i] = r(t+i+1), 각 시점의 G_t 계산
    returns = [0.0] * len(rewards)
    g = 0.0
    for i in reversed(range(len(rewards))):
        g = rewards[i] + gamma * g  # G_t = r + γ·G_(t+1)
        returns[i] = g
    return returns

# 예: [1, 1, 1], gamma=0.9 → [2.71, 1.9, 1.0]

def des(initial_events, end_time):
    clock = 0.0
    fel = PriorityQueue(initial_events)  # 사건 리스트
    stats = Stats()
    while not fel.empty():
        time, event = fel.pop_min()  # 가장 이른 사건
        if time > end_time:
            break
        clock = time  # 시계를 사건 시각으로 점프
        new_events = handle(event, clock, stats)
        for t, e in new_events:  # 후속 사건 예약
            fel.push(t, e)
    return stats.summarize()  # 신뢰구간 등

disk-scheduling.pseudocode:
def fcfs(head, queue):
    total = 0
    for r in queue:  # 도착 순서대로
        total += abs(r - head)
        head = r
    return total

def sstf(head, queue):
    pending, total = list(queue), 0
    while pending:
        # 현재 헤드에서 가장 가까운 요청 선택
        r = min(pending, key=lambda x: abs(x - head))
        total += abs(r - head)

INF = float('inf')

def dv_update(me, cost, vectors, dist, nxt):
    # cost[v]: 이웃 v까지 링크 비용
    # vectors[v][y]: 이웃 v가 알린 y까지 거리
    dests = set(cost)
    for v in vectors:
        dests |= set(vectors[v])
    changed = False
    for y in dests - {me}:
        best, via = INF, None
        for v in cost:  # 벨만-포드 최소 선택
            dv = 0 if y == v else vectors[v].get(y, INF)
            if cost[v] + dv < best:
                best, via = cost[v] + dv, v
        if best != dist.get(y, INF):
            dist[y], nxt[y] = best, via
            changed = True
    return changed  # True면 이웃에게 벡터 전송

def merge_sort(a):
    if len(a) <= 1:  # 기저: 직접 해결
        return a
    mid = len(a) // 2  # 분할
    left = merge_sort(a[:mid])  # 정복(재귀)
    right = merge_sort(a[mid:])
    return merge(left, right)  # 결합

def merge(l, r):
    out, i, j = [], 0, 0
    while i < len(l) and j < len(r):
        if l[i] <= r[j]:
            out.append(l[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            out.append(r[j])
            j += 1
    return out + l[i:] + r[j:]

# T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n) → O(n log n)
